svg.title: Milin Patel: safety and security of AI-based perception for automated driving
svg.desc: A bird's-eye LiDAR view: the sweep scans the road, cars are detected, and a pedestrian crossing ahead is tracked while a safety monitor reacts as the detection becomes uncertain.

g.text: Safety and security of AI-based perception
Building trust in machines that see.
From hazard analysis to the open road.
